svg.aria-label: Documentation reader, terminal pipelines and the snap-layout menu

g.text: what this is and is not
A complete Linux desktop environment that boots, runs and remembers —
NOVA Linux is a desktop environment simulator: a web application that behaves
like a small, polished Linux distribution. It has a boot sequence, a login
screen, a window manager and a virtual file system persisted in IndexedDB.
It is not a kernel, a VM or a remote desktop. Nothing is executed natively.
Snap layouts and a restored window session
A shell with pipes, redirection, grep, head and wc
Code on the desktop, with a Markdown preview
